title: Implement per-song aubio authoring and safe chart generation
description: Implement a configurable JSON collection of per-song chart-authoring settings and the aubioonset-based generator. Configure only the existing playable song, identified by stable ID and source path; do not guess excerpt settings for other audio. Its settings are start_time 107.1 seconds, excerpt-relative twilight_time 39.2 seconds, duration 65.8 seconds, minimum_delta 64 milliseconds, stride 2, and lane_rules {type: pattern, data: [0, 2, 1, 3]}. Load and validate the collection, use it as the defaults for generation/checking, and preserve useful CLI overrides and explicit song selection. Extract full-source onset timestamps with installed aubioonset in seconds; greedily retain onsets at least minimum_delta after the last retained onset (equality retained), apply stride to retained onsets, then apply unchanged chart timing guards without resetting at Twilight. Preserve raw onset list, source indices/times, source hash, settings, and tool commands in provenance. Update tests and authoring docs, regenerate the current chart/artifact with installed tools, and verify source/lockfile hashes remain unchanged. No installs/downloads, remote changes, or commits.
acceptance_criteria: Per-song JSON schema/validation, config-driven generation/check, explicit aubioonset detector settings, selection/provenance guards, alternate-source live destination protection, and onset-derived copy are implemented. Independent 43-Python/123-Vitest GREEN, typecheck/lint/format/build/chartcheck/browser checks and BC-03/BC-04 review accepted. Current artifact/chart regenerated; source and lockfile hashes unchanged. Human musical acceptance remains in shining-stars-4v0.7.
notes: Implemented configurable per-song JSON settings for the playable song, aubioonset extraction/provenance, greedy minimum_delta then stride selection, safe live-output policy for alternate sources, and onset-derived UI copy. Regenerated artifact/chart with 1,311 raw onsets and 80 selected notes (44 Audience/36 Twilight). Independent verification passed 43 Python tests, 123 Vitest tests, typecheck, lint, format, build, chart check, and browser checks. BC-03/BC-04 reviewer findings are closed. User listening/play-test remains tracked by shining-stars-4v0.7. No installs or remote changes.
close_reason: Implementation complete; independent 43-Python/123-Vitest GREEN, typecheck/lint/format/build/chart-check and browser verification passed. BC-03/BC-04 reviewer findings closed; live output protection and onset-derived UI copy accepted. Local checkpoint follows; no remote push.
